newsitem.title: INDIA: ANZ Grindlays cuts Indian prime rate to 16.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: ANZ Grindlays cuts Indian prime rate to 16.0 pct.

text.p: ANZ Grindlays Bank said on Tuesday it cut its Indian prime lending rate to 16 percent from 17 percent.
The new rate takes effect from April 25, a bank statement said.
The statement said ANZ cut its prime rate because of the credit policy announced on April 15.
The Reserve Bank of India announced steps to reduce deposit interest rates in its credit policy for first half 1997/98 (April-March) hoping to spark off cuts in bank lending rates.

ANZ said it expected the downward revision in its prime rate to lead to increased disbursements in rupee lending, especially to the infrastructure sector, in keeping with the objectives of the credit policy.
